-- class: expand
-- name: create

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" text not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-matview
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create materialized view "public"."task_titles" as select id, title from tasks with no data;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create unique index "task_titles_id" on "public"."task_titles" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: refresh-matview
-- action: backfill
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
refresh materialized view "public"."task_titles";
